source: Cloudy quartz forms a pale band inside the massif.
en: Cloudy quartz forms a pale band inside the massif.
de: Milchiger Quarz bildet ein helles Band im Gebirge.

source: A seam of raw amethyst cuts through the gneiss.
en: A seam of raw amethyst cuts through the gneiss.
de: Eine Ader aus rohem Amethyst durchzieht den Gneis.

source: Dark mica glints on the polished rock face.
en: Dark mica glints on the polished rock face.
de: Dunkler Glimmer glänzt auf der polierten Felsfläche.

source: Honey-gold auricite lies in a fractured quartz seam.
en: Honey-gold auricite lies in a fractured quartz seam.
de: Honiggoldener Aurizit sitzt in einer geborstenen Quarzader.

source: Glacial silt holds chips of quartz, slate and mica.
en: Glacial silt holds chips of quartz, slate and mica.
de: Gletscherschluff bindet Splitter aus Quarz, Schiefer und Glimmer.

source: Long joints split this weathered alpine gneiss.
en: Long joints split this weathered alpine gneiss.
de: Lange Klüfte spalten diesen verwitterten Alpengneis.

source: A violet quartz prism from a highland crystal crown.
en: A violet quartz prism from a highland crystal crown.
de: Ein violettes Quarzprisma aus einer Hochland-Kristallkrone.

source: Cold blue crystal grows beside the amethyst dikes.
en: Cold blue crystal grows beside the amethyst dikes.
de: Eisblauer Kristall wächst entlang der Amethystgänge.

source: Courses of dressed lavender stone line the vault.
en: Courses of dressed lavender stone line the vault.
de: Behauene lavendelfarbene Quader säumen den Tresor.

source: Gold wire traces a rune across the dressed stone.
en: Gold wire traces a rune across the dressed stone.
de: Golddraht zeichnet eine Rune auf dem behauenen Stein.

source: Overlapping violet slates shed snow from the tower roof.
en: Overlapping violet slates shed snow from the tower roof.
de: Überlappende violette Schieferplatten halten Schnee vom Turmdach ab.

source: Small quartz points sprout from a common matrix.
en: Small quartz points sprout from a common matrix.
de: Kleine Quarzspitzen wachsen aus einem gemeinsamen Muttergestein.

source: Amethyst and icy blue quartz meet in a radial crown.
en: Amethyst and icy blue quartz meet in a radial crown.
de: Amethyst und eisblauer Quarz bilden einen strahlenförmigen Kranz.

source: Facets of amber-gold auricite emerge from a gray matrix.
en: Facets of amber-gold auricite emerge from a gray matrix.
de: Bernsteingoldene Aurizitfacetten ragen aus grauem Muttergestein.

source: Gold and violet minerals occupy the same fissure.
en: Gold and violet minerals occupy the same fissure.
de: Goldene und violette Minerale füllen dieselbe Kluft.

source: Pink saxifrage opens among wind-sheltered stones.
en: Pink saxifrage opens among wind-sheltered stones.
de: Rosa Steinbrech blüht im Windschatten der Felsen.

source: Narrow blades bend away from the exposed ridge.
en: Narrow blades bend away from the exposed ridge.
de: Schmale Halme neigen sich im Wind des freiliegenden Grats.

source: A cushion of silver-tipped moss clings to the scree.
en: A cushion of silver-tipped moss clings to the scree.
de: Ein silbrig bereiftes Moospolster haftet am Geröll.

source: Weathered fragments gather at the foot of a cliff.
en: Weathered fragments gather at the foot of a cliff.
de: Verwitterte Bruchstücke sammeln sich am Fuß der Klippe.

source: Glacial ice carried this fractured boulder to the ledge.
en: Glacial ice carried this fractured boulder to the ledge.
de: Gletschereis hat diesen zerklüfteten Findling auf den Felsvorsprung getragen.

source: An amethyst seal crowns the ancient repository.
en: An amethyst seal crowns the ancient repository.
de: Ein Amethystsiegel krönt die alte Schatzkammer.
